purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: The district land-records page links UP Bhulekh; official dashboards report cadastral map sheets and georeferenced villages across Sultanpur tehsils, including Sultanpur tehsil. UP revenue pages describe plot maps as revenue-village maps and BhuNaksha is an official revenue map tool; the national NIC description says the map-management application is for authorized officials. Aggregate village statistics do not identify the point’s map extent, and no safe anonymous full geometry response was verified. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
